description: %redefine-const reads its own name as the previous value, then extends, narrows or replaces it. Other references use the final stage definitions (engine §2).
grammar:
%const $A (B ∪ C)
%redefine-const $A ($A ∪ D)
%const $N (B ∪ C ∪ D)
%redefine-const $N ($N ∖ C)
%redefine-const $N ($N ∩ (B ∪ E))
%const $R B
%redefine-const $R E
%rule text $x:X %conditions $A = (B ∪ C ∪ D), $N = B, $R = E
